-- Alabama Governor: Tuberville (R) vs Doug Jones (D)
UPDATE governor_races
SET dem_candidate = 'Doug Jones',
    rep_candidate = 'Tommy Tuberville',
    dem_previous_office = 'U.S. Senator, Alabama (2018-2021)',
    rep_previous_office = 'U.S. Senator, Alabama (2021-2027)',
    dem_bio = 'Former U.S. Senator who won a historic 2017 special election. Known for prosecuting KKK members as U.S. Attorney.',
    rep_bio = 'Trump-backed former Auburn football coach and U.S. Senator. Won 2020 Senate race by 20 points.',
    notes = 'Tuberville won the R primary (98.9% in). Jones won the D primary. Rematch of their 2020 Senate race, which Tuberville won by 20 points. Rated Solid R.',
    status = 'Voting',
    pct_reporting = 98.90
WHERE state_code = 'AL';

-- Idaho Governor: Brad Little (R, incumbent) advancing — D primary results TBD
UPDATE governor_races
SET rep_previous_office = 'Governor of Idaho (2019-present)',
    rep_bio = 'Incumbent Republican governor. Won 2022 re-election by 21 points. Former Lt. Governor.',
    notes = 'Little won R primary (98.2% in). D nominee TBD — primary still being counted.',
    status = 'Voting',
    pct_reporting = 98.20
WHERE state_code = 'ID';

-- Nebraska: Jim Pillen (R) vs Lynne Walz (D) — already set, just update status
UPDATE governor_races
SET dem_previous_office = 'Nebraska State Senator (2015-2023)',
    rep_previous_office = 'Governor of Nebraska (2023-present)',
    dem_bio = 'Former Nebraska state senator and House Minority Leader. Running on education and healthcare platform.',
    rep_bio = 'Incumbent Republican governor and hog farmer. Won 2022 race by 19 points.',
    notes = 'Pillen won R primary (98.3% in). Walz won D primary. Rated Solid R.',
    status = 'Voting',
    pct_reporting = 98.30
WHERE state_code = 'NE';
